bullets: Energy comes in many forms - light, heat, sound, movement and stored energy - and it can travel and change from one form to another
slides.heading: Forms of energy
slides.notes: Welcome everyone in and say: today we meet five forms of energy - light racing outward, heat rising, sound spreading, movement sliding along, and stored energy waiting quietly - then we watch energy travel and change form.

bullets: Name five forms of energy: light, heat, sound, movement and stored energy
Spot the forms of energy we use every day in a lamp, a pot, a radio and a car
Explain why energy is never used up, even when a lamp or a toy stops
slides.heading: What we will learn
slides.notes: Read the three goals aloud and tell the class: keep these in mind, because the exit ticket at the end will ask you to name the forms, trace one change of form, and spot the mistake about energy being used up.

bullets: A pupil says energy is used up when the lamp goes off, like fuel disappearing from a tank
Has the energy really gone, or has it changed form and moved somewhere else?
slides.heading: Is energy used up?
slides.notes: Pose the claim from scene s4 without the verdict first: ask for a show of hands on whether energy is used up, take two or three answers without judging them, and say scene s4 settles this exactly.

bullets: Energy is what makes things happen: it lets us see, warms things up, carries sound and makes things move
Energy is never used up: it changes form and moves somewhere else
slides.heading: Energy changes form and moves on
slides.notes: Say this slowly, because it is the big idea of the whole lesson: energy travels from place to place and changes from one form to another - electrical energy becomes light and heat, stored energy becomes movement and heat - but it never disappears.

bullets: Light rays spread out in straight lines from the lamp, heat rises up, and sound spreads out from where it is made
Movement slides along, while stored energy waits quietly in its box until it is needed
slides.heading: Energy comes in many forms
slides.notes: Narrate each form as it moves in the animation: watch the light rays lengthen and spread, the heat circle drift upwards, the sound lines spread outward, the movement circle slide along, and the stored dot drop into its box and wait.

bullets: A lamp sends out light, cooking heat rises from the pot, and a radio sends out sound
A car turns stored energy in its fuel into movement as it rolls along
slides.heading: We use energy every day
slides.notes: Point to each everyday use in turn: the lamp rays reaching up, the steam puffs rising as heat escapes from the pot, the radio sound lines spreading out, and the car rolling as stored energy becomes movement.

bullets: Electrical energy waits stored in the battery, then travels along the wire to the bulb
At the bulb the electrical energy changes into two forms at once: light and heat
slides.heading: Energy changes form
slides.notes: Follow the yellow dot as the energy travels along the wire from the battery to the bulb, then watch the bulb light up: one form of energy - electrical - has changed into light, with some leaving as rising heat.

bullets: The energy dot travels from the stored circle to the heat circle - it does not vanish on the way
Energy is never used up: it changes form and moves somewhere else
slides.heading: A common mistake: is energy used up?
slides.notes: Hold the mistake up first - energy is used up, like fuel disappearing from a tank - then cross it out and follow the dot along the chain from stored to heat: the same energy, in a new form and a new place.

bullets: Start with the battery: electrical energy travels along the wire and arrives at the bulb
Each stop is a change of form: electrical energy becomes light and heat
slides.heading: Worked example: follow the energy to the bulb
slides.notes: Talk through scene s3 slowly and name each change of form: the energy waits stored in the battery, travels along the wire as electrical energy, then leaves the bulb as light to see by and heat rising into the air.

bullets: Trace the chain for a radio: electrical energy in, sound spreading out - where has the rest gone?
Explain to your partner why energy is not used up when a torch battery runs flat, using the words changes form in your answer
slides.heading: Your turn: trace the energy chain
slides.notes: Give pairs three minutes, then cold-call one pair on each chain: press them to end with the energy in a new form somewhere else, never with the energy being used up or gone.

bullets: On your own: name the five forms of energy and give one everyday use for each
Explain in one sentence why energy is never used up, even when a lamp stops shining
slides.heading: Exit ticket: show what you know
slides.notes: Collect these before anyone leaves and say: I am looking for all five forms named with a use for each, plus one clear sentence about energy changing form and moving somewhere else.
